{"test_name": "Ledger_2297_Objection1", "test_code": "using System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection1\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task GeneratedFormattersAndResolvers_HaveExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute()\n    {\n        string source = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace TestNamespace\n{\n    public enum SampleEnum\n    {\n        First = 0,\n        Second = 1,\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class IntKeyModel\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Id { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(1)]\n        public SampleEnum Kind { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject(true)]\n    public class StringKeyModel\n    {\n        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;\n    }\n\n    [Union(0, typeof(UnionImplA))]\n    [Union(1, typeof(UnionImplB))]\n    public interface ISampleUnion\n    {\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class UnionImplA : ISampleUnion\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int A { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class UnionImplB : ISampleUnion\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public string B { get; set; } = string.Empty;\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> frameworkRefs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        IEnumerable<MetadataReference> references = frameworkRefs.Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation output, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.Empty(output.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol excludeAttrSymbol = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\")\n            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException(\"ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute not found.\");\n        INamedTypeSymbol formatterInterface = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"MessagePack.Formatters.IMessagePackFormatter`1\")\n            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException(\"IMessagePackFormatter<T> not found.\");\n        INamedTypeSymbol resolverInterface = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"MessagePack.IFormatterResolver\")\n            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException(\"IFormatterResolver not found.\");\n\n        var formattedTargetTypeNames = new HashSet<string>();\n        var generatedResolverNames = new List<string>();\n\n        foreach (GeneratedSourceResult generatedSource in runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources))\n        {\n            SemanticModel semanticModel = output.GetSemanticModel(generatedSource.SyntaxTree);\n            SyntaxNode root = await generatedSource.SyntaxTree.GetRootAsync();\n\n            foreach (TypeDeclarationSyntax typeDecl in root.DescendantNodes().OfType<TypeDeclarationSyntax>())\n            {\n                if (semanticModel.GetDeclaredSymbol(typeDecl) is not INamedTypeSymbol typeSymbol)\n                {\n                    continue;\n                }\n\n                INamedTypeSymbol? implementedFormatter = typeSymbol.AllInterfaces.FirstOrDefault(\n                    i => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(i.OriginalDefinition, formatterInterface));\n                bool isResolver = typeSymbol.AllInterfaces.Any(\n                    i => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(i, resolverInterface));\n\n                if (implementedFormatter is null && !isResolver)\n                {\n                    continue;\n                }\n\n                bool hasExcludeAttrSymbol = typeSymbol.GetAttributes().Any(\n                    a => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(a.AttributeClass, excludeAttrSymbol));\n                Assert.True(\n                    hasExcludeAttrSymbol,\n                    $\"Generated type '{typeSymbol.ToDisplayString()}' in '{generatedSource.HintName}' is missing ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute.\");\n\n                bool hasGlobalQualifiedExcludeAttrSyntax = typeDecl.AttributeLists\n                    .SelectMany(al => al.Attributes)\n                    .Any(a => a.Name.ToString().Contains(\"global::System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverage\"));\n                Assert.True(\n                    hasGlobalQualifiedExcludeAttrSyntax,\n                    $\"Generated type '{typeSymbol.ToDisplayString()}' in '{generatedSource.HintName}' does not emit [global::System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverage].\");\n\n                if (implementedFormatter is not null)\n                {\n                    formattedTargetTypeNames.Add(implementedFormatter.TypeArguments[0].ToDisplayString());\n                }\n\n                if (isResolver)\n                {\n                    generatedResolverNames.Add(typeSymbol.ToDisplayString());\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        Assert.Contains(\"TestNamespace.IntKeyModel\", formattedTargetTypeNames);\n        Assert.Contains(\"TestNamespace.StringKeyModel\", formattedTargetTypeNames);\n        Assert.Contains(\"TestNamespace.SampleEnum\", formattedTargetTypeNames);\n        Assert.Contains(\"TestNamespace.ISampleUnion\", formattedTargetTypeNames);\n        Assert.NotEmpty(generatedResolverNames);\n    }\n}\n"}
